name: 王儀雯
objective:
本課程在介紹及闡述化學原理及物質之性質，著重於現代化學理論及概念之導入。內容包括氣體、計量化學、原子結構、化學鍵、物質狀態、能量轉換、酸鹼理論、氧化還原反應、金屬及非金屬元素、核化學。
Introduction to the principles of chemistry and properties of matter, which are explained in terms of modern chemical theory with emphasis on conceptual problems. Individual topics include gas, stoichiometry, atomic structure, chemical bonding, and the states of matter, energy relation, acid-base theory and oxidation-reduction reactions, the chemistry of metallic and nonmetallic elements, nuclear chemistry.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week#1: Chemical Foundations
Week#2: Atoms, Molecules and Ions
Week#3: Stoichiometry
Week#4: Types of Chemical Reactions and Solution Stoichiometry
Week#5: Quiz 
Week#6: Atomic Structure and Periodicity
Week#7: Bonding
Week#8: Liquids and Solids
Week#9: Mid-term exam
Week#10: Chemical Kinetics
Week#11: Chemical Equilibrium
Week#12: Acids and Bases
Week#13: Quiz
Week#14: Solubility and Complex Ion Equilibria
Week#15: Spontaneity, Entropy and Free Energy
Week#16: Final-term exam
